description:
Approved by the user (relayed by Elixir Parity, 2026-11-20) in the fz-mue.12 amendment, which chose a full %Macro.Env{} for __CALLER__ and __ENV__ (field table in /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-mue.12.html). Until this lands versioned_vars is %{} because fz's expander does not track variables. Done: the expander tracks the variables bound at the macro call site, and Macro.Env.versioned_vars, Macro.Env.vars/1 and Macro.Env.has_var?/2 answer as Elixir does. Owner: Elixir Parity.

Re-test on develop de4ef6a3b (Elixir Parity, 2026-11-24; user-approved update): Macro.Env.versioned_vars/1, vars/1 and has_var?/2 are not defined at all: lib/macro_env.fz has only in_guard?/in_match?, and the field is %{}. Evidence: Elixir Parity's fresh/report.md.

comments.text: User approved page /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-mue.45.html (2026-11-24) with all recommendations: exact versions (one counter per function, as Elixir); = expands its right side first (any pin that moves goes to the user with its cause); build after the epic's blockers (mue.28, .10, nhb.15, .51 commit 2), as the last parity piece of %Macro.Env{}. Probes: scratchpad mue45 p1-p3.exs, copied to ../fz-otp-json/probes/mue45/.

title: The macro expander knows the caller's variables, so Macro.Env.versioned_vars, vars/1 and has_var?/2 are as in Elixir
